data.name: Beston
data.description: Beston Group is a Chinese pyrolysis equipment manufacturer based in Zhengzhou/Jiaozuo, Henan, operating as the environmental protection division of Henan Golee Group. Its product range spans pyrolysis plants for plastic, tyres, oil sludge, rubber, and biomass-to-biochar, with the biochar line marketed to CDR project operators after receiving Puro.earth technology vetting and, in February 2026, pre-approval from Isometric. They supply BST-series biochar reactors to projects including Euthenia Energy in Spain and a North American almond-shell project.
